name: Voice Chat (External Whisper Server)
description: Requires an external faster-whisper Wyoming TCP server running outside Terra (e.g. linuxserver/faster-whisper on port 10300). Docks directly into Biketerra's in-game chat zone with Zwift Ride Push-to-Talk or hands-free Auto mode.

settings.label: Whisper server IP / hostname
settings.description: LAN IP or hostname of your Unraid server running linuxserver/faster-whisper (e.g. 192.168.1.50).

settings.label: Language
settings.description: ISO language code (e.g. en, sv, de) or 'auto'. Fixed language (e.g. en) avoids misdetections on short words.

settings.label: Default mic mode
settings.description: ptt = Push-to-Talk (Zwift Ride RB or hotkey) · auto = Rowing hands-free (shows draft, say 'send it' or 'cancel')

settings.label: Wake phrases (legacy wake mode)
settings.description: Optional comma-separated trigger phrases if wake mode is used.

settings.label: Keyboard PTT hotkey
settings.description: KeyboardEvent.code to hold for Push-to-Talk (e.g. KeyV, Backquote). Blank to disable keyboard PTT.

settings.label: Biketerra chat hotkey
settings.description: Biketerra key used to open chat if the chat input is closed (default: KeyT).

settings.label: Auto-open Biketerra chat on ride start
settings.description: Automatically opens Biketerra's in-game chat panel when entering a ride so Voice Chat stays attached beneath it.

settings.label: After PTT transcription
settings.description: countdown = 2s cancelable preview · voice = show draft & wait for 'send'/'cancel' · immediate = post right away · fill = type only

settings.label: In AUTO rowing mode
settings.description: voice = show draft and wait for you to say 'send' or 'cancel' · countdown = 2s auto-send · immediate = post straight to chat · fill = type only

settings.label: Browser echo & noise suppression
settings.description: Off = cleaner raw mic audio for Whisper (recommended unless speakers are loud). Enable if bike/fan noise triggers too easily.

settings.label: Microphone input source
settings.description: Auto (BT on Android) selects a connected Bluetooth headset on Android while leaving desktop mic choice to your OS. 'Prefer Bluetooth' tries Bluetooth everywhere.

settings.label: Gentle auto-gain for quiet mic clips
settings.description: Softly boosts quiet laptop mic recordings (up to 4x) before sending to Whisper.

settings.label: Silence stop delay (ms)
settings.description: Hands-free silence duration after speech before sending clip to Whisper (600–3000 ms).

settings.label: Hands-free mic sensitivity (1–10)
settings.description: Higher = picks up quieter speech; lower = ignores louder rower flywheel/fan noise.

settings.label: Max clip length (sec)
settings.description: Safety cap for a single voice clip (5–45 s).
